subject: general
question: Which of the following units is used to measure only basic physical quantities?
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Basic Unit**

 
• Basic units are the fundamental units of measurement that are used to express physical quantities in the simplest form. These units form the foundation of the measurement system and are not derived from any other units. They are defined by the International System of Units (SI) and are used to measure basic physical quantities like length, mass, time, electric current, temperature, amount of substance, and luminous intensity.
